# SqlSourceTokenizer

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Intellisense.SqlSourceTokenizer`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Tokenizes SQL text for syntax highlighting using ScriptDom&#x27;s Microsoft.SqlServer.TransactSql.ScriptDom.TSql170Parser. Maps Microsoft.SqlServer.TransactSql.ScriptDom.TSqlTokenType to PPDS.Dataverse.Sql.Intellisense.SourceTokenType for rendering. Never throws — invalid input produces Error tokens for the unparseable region.
